fit_reason: Although posted under boats by owner, the listing directs buyers to call Knotty Oar Marina, offers free winterization and storage, and reads as a marina or dealer listing rather than a private owner sale.
findings: Pontoon logs look clean with no obvious oxidation or waterline staining visible
Black and white side panels appear glossy and clean on both sides
Bimini top and upholstery visible from outside look clean
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Crest pontoon. It already looks clean, with glossy side panels and tidy pontoon logs in the photos. If you ever want a pre-sale detail or log polish, we come to you. Would you like a quote?
